title: Sample Trial for KRAS G12C Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
trialSpaceText: Age range allowed: 18 years and older. Sex allowed: Both. Cancer type allowed: non-small cell lung cancer. Histology allowed: adenocarcinoma or squamous carcinoma. Cancer burden allowed: metastatic or unresectable advanced disease. Prior treatment required: prior platinum chemotherapy and prior immune checkpoint inhibitor. Prior treatment excluded: prior KRAS G12C inhibitor. Biomarkers required: KRAS G12C mutation. Biomarkers excluded: NA.
boilerplateText: Poor performance status, uncontrolled brain metastases, active pneumonitis, clinically significant heart failure, severe renal dysfunction, severe liver dysfunction, active uncontrolled infection.

title: Sample Trial for HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer
trialSpaceText: Age range allowed: 18 years and older. Sex allowed: Both. Cancer type allowed: breast cancer. Histology allowed: invasive breast carcinoma. Cancer burden allowed: metastatic disease. Prior treatment required: prior trastuzumab and taxane. Prior treatment excluded: NA. Biomarkers required: HER2-positive disease. Biomarkers excluded: NA.
boilerplateText: Uncontrolled central nervous system metastases, significant cardiac dysfunction, active interstitial lung disease, uncontrolled infection, pregnancy.

title: Sample Phase 1 Trial for Advanced Solid Tumors
trialSpaceText: Age range allowed: 18 years and older. Sex allowed: Both. Cancer type allowed: any advanced solid tumor. Histology allowed: solid tumor. Cancer burden allowed: metastatic or unresectable disease. Prior treatment required: standard therapies exhausted or unavailable. Prior treatment excluded: NA. Biomarkers required: NA. Biomarkers excluded: NA.
boilerplateText: Poor performance status, uncontrolled brain metastases, clinically significant cardiovascular disease, active autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy, severe renal dysfunction, severe liver dysfunction.
